archive librarian of a dead language, near-future, rendered as painterly gouache concept art moodboard, a punchy saturated candy palette, unglazed stoneware

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Lighting reference: LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
